name: Ebony Rose
source:
Follow the drama in Rena's relationship with her lover Charles and her best friend Stella. It looks like everything is good and lovely between them because of their friendship and their conflicts, but it seems like it was from the outside of the relationship, looking into it more to see what will happen to them.
